designStackBlock.title: Design stack
designStackBlock.description: An editable tool inventory composed from Container and DataGrid, with category badges, websites, renewal dates and undo/redo.
designStackBlock.compositionBody: Container owns the frame, header and footer. DataGrid directly owns the floating work surface and scrolling, without an extra ContainerBody surface. Its built-in text, select, URL and date editors retain Zeron styles. The public short-text leading slot contains Avatar with bundled brand artwork or a fallback. Checkbox, Badge and Button use their public APIs. Colors, typography, sizes and state feedback come from Zeron semantic tokens.
designStackBlock.behaviorBody: Double-click or press Enter/F2 to edit. Use column menus to sort, pin or hide fields. Select rows to delete or clear selection; Add row creates a stable new ID. The local history hook records edits, additions and deletions, supports Undo/Redo and Ctrl/Cmd+Z, and clears redo after a new edit. Escape cancels text changes. A focused cell shows its spreadsheet coordinate in the footer. Hosts supply controlled items and synchronous changes; omitting onItemsChange makes the grid read-only. The demo uses local browser memory and does not persist or call an external service.
